Flow.description: Quick action on a renewal Opportunity. Merges other open renewal opportunities on the same account (same price book and currency) into this one, optionally with the account's renewable assets that no open renewal covers: renews the root assets of all their lines (and those assets) onto one quote linked to this opportunity, cotermed to an end date the user picks (default one year after the latest asset ends), then closes the others as Closed Lost. Initiate Renewal takes one start date per call, so it is called once per asset end date, the first call creating the quote and later ones adding to it through renewRecordId. Which assets an open renewal already covers is read by RLM_RenewalCoveredAssets in system context, so renewals the user can't see still count. After the confirmation screen everything is read again and nothing is renewed unless it still matches what the user confirmed, down to each root asset's end and renewal term. The contract is passed only when every opportunity shares it and it links every root asset. A line linked to no asset, on this or a selected opportunity, stops the flow, since consolidating would drop that product. So does an existing quote on these opportunities, or a renewal quote for one of the assets on any other opportunity, open or closed, that hasn't been ordered and activated (either could still be ordered, renewing the same assets again), or a line for one of the assets on an open opportunity left out (it would stay open, and a renewal quote could still be generated from it), a root asset or component sold from another price book or in another currency (a renewal must use those of the initial sale), ramped, or with a period in a time zone other than GMT (renewal lines keep the asset's time zone, the end is set in GMT, and one quote can't mix time zones). Assets whose renewal would start before today (GMT) can't be cotermed.

formulas.description: What the renewal of this asset depends on: the asset, its exact end, and its renewal term.
formulas.name: AssetSignature

formulas.description: The day the asset ends in GMT, like every other date here. DATEVALUE on the datetime would use the user's time zone, a day late east of GMT for an end at 23:59:59 GMT.
formulas.name: CheckAssetEndDate

formulas.description: Initiate Renewal can't start a renewal before today, so the exact start the asset would get (the second after it ends) must fall today or later. Both dates are taken in GMT, the days Initiate Renewal uses.
formulas.name: IsCheckAssetCurrent

formulas.description: One year after the latest asset ends.
formulas.name: DefaultTargetEndDate

formulas.description: One second after the group ends. Initiate Renewal rejects any other start, and adding to the end datetime keeps it independent of the user's time zone, which a date conversion is not.
formulas.name: GroupStartDateTime

formulas.description: The last second (GMT) of the chosen date, the value Initiate Renewal stores for any end on that date. Passing midnight instead can put the end at or before a group's start, which it rejects.
formulas.name: TargetEndDateTime

formulas.description: The note goes first and the existing description is kept after it, cut to the 32,000 characters Description holds, so a long one can't fail the close. The date is the GMT day, like every other date here.
formulas.name: ConsolidatedDescription
formulas.expression: LEFT("Consolidated into " & {!Get_Primary_Opportunity.Name} & " (" & {!Get_Primary_Opportunity.Id} & ") on " & LEFT(TEXT(NOW()), 10) & " (GMT)." & IF(ISBLANK({!Loop_Close_Renewals.Description}), "", BR() & BR() & {!Loop_Close_Renewals.Description}), 32000)

formulas.description: True when the contract to pass is the one the user confirmed (both may be blank).

recordLookups.label: Get Current Opportunities

recordLookups.description: The root assets the shared contract actually links. An opportunity's contract doesn't prove its assets belong to it: a quote that absorbed other assets, or added account assets, can carry assets from elsewhere. Relationship dates are not filtered: Initiate Renewal accepts a relationship that has ended or not yet started, and a relationship normally ends with the contract term the renewal follows. The renewal reads the term from the asset, which every root asset must have, so it never needs a current relationship to copy the contract's term.

recordLookups.label: Get Contract Assets

recordRollbacks.name: Roll_Back_Renewal
recordRollbacks.label: Roll Back Renewal

fields.name: Other_Open_Renewal_AssetsText
fields.fieldText:
An asset to renew is also on a line of another open opportunity that isn't being consolidated, so nothing was consolidated. Renewing it here would leave that opportunity open, and a renewal quote could still be generated from it, renewing the asset a second time.

Select that opportunity too if it is listed, or close it or remove that line, then try again.

fields.name: Other_Price_Book_AssetsText
fields.fieldText:
An asset to renew was sold from a different price book or in a different currency than this opportunity uses, so nothing was consolidated. A renewal must use the price book and currency of the asset's initial sale.

Leave out the opportunity that asset is on, or the account's other assets if it is one of them, then try again.

fields.name: Pending_Renewal_QuotesText
fields.fieldText:
One of these assets is already on a renewal quote on another opportunity (open or closed) that hasn't been ordered and activated, so nothing was consolidated. That quote could still be ordered, whatever its status or dates, and activating the order would renew the asset a second time.

Delete that quote, and any draft order from it, first, then try again.

fields.name: Existing_QuotesText
fields.fieldText:
This or a selected opportunity already has a quote, so nothing was consolidated. That quote could still be ordered, whatever its status, and activating the order would renew the same assets a second time.

Leave that opportunity out, or delete its quotes first, then try again.

fields.name: SelectionErrorText
fields.fieldText: Select at least one opportunity or include the other assets.

fields.name: SelectRenewalsText
fields.fieldText: Choose what to merge into {!Get_Primary_Opportunity.Name}. Everything is renewed on one quote linked to this opportunity, and the selected opportunities are closed as Closed Lost.

fields.name: Include_Account_Assets
fields.fieldText: Also renew the {!ExtraAssetCount} other renewable assets on this account that no open renewal opportunity covers

fields.name: ConfirmText
fields.fieldText:
Renew {!RootAssetCount} assets on one quote for {!Get_Primary_Opportunity.Name}?

Each asset renews from the day after it ends to the end date below, so the renewal is cotermed. The latest asset ends on {!LatestEndDate}. Then {!ClosingCount} selected opportunities are closed as Closed Lost.

fields.name: TargetEndDate
fields.fieldText: Renewal End Date

validationRule.errorMessage: Choose a later date. The latest asset ends on {!LatestEndDate}, and the renewal must end after it.

fields.name: Non_Gmt_AssetsText
fields.fieldText:
An asset to renew uses a time zone other than GMT, so nothing was consolidated. Renewal lines keep their asset's time zone, and this action coterms only GMT assets: it ends the renewal at 11:59:59 PM GMT, and one quote can't mix time zones.

Renew assets in other time zones with Generate Renewal Quote instead.

fields.name: Not_Open_RenewalText
fields.fieldText:
{!Get_Primary_Opportunity.Name} isn't an open renewal opportunity, so nothing was consolidated.

This action works on open opportunities with Type Existing Business.

fields.name: No_Other_RenewalsText
fields.fieldText: There is nothing to consolidate into {!Get_Primary_Opportunity.Name}: no other open renewal opportunities on this account share its price book and currency, and every renewable asset on the account is already on an open renewal.

fields.name: No_Renewable_AssetsText
fields.fieldText: Nothing selected is linked to an asset, so there is nothing to renew.

fields.name: Assets_Not_ReadableText
fields.fieldText:
You don't have access to {!MissingAssetCount} of the {!LineAssetCount} assets on the selected opportunities, so nothing was consolidated. A quote made without them would leave those products out of the renewal.

Ask your admin for access to the account's assets, then try again.

fields.name: Unlinked_LinesText
fields.fieldText:
A product on this or a selected opportunity isn't linked to an asset ({!Get_Unlinked_Lines.Name}), so nothing was consolidated. The renewal quote holds only renewed assets, so consolidating would drop that product.

Remove the product or quote it separately, or leave its opportunity out, then try again.

fields.name: Unrenewable_AssetsText
fields.fieldText:
These assets can't be cotermed: {!UnrenewableAssetNames}

Each needs a renewal term and unit and an end date late enough that its renewal, which starts the second after it ends, starts today or later (in GMT), because a renewal can't start in the past. Set Renewal Term and Renewal Term Unit on them (for example in the Managed Asset viewer), or renew expired assets on their own with a new start date, then try again.

fields.name: Consolidation_ErrorText
fields.fieldText:
The renewals were not consolidated.

{!$Flow.FaultMessage}

Nothing was saved, so you can try again once the problem is fixed.

fields.name: Close_ErrorText
fields.fieldText:
The other opportunities couldn't be closed, so the renewals were not consolidated.

{!$Flow.FaultMessage}

The renewal quote was undone too, so nothing was saved; you can try again once the problem is fixed.

fields.name: Root_Assets_Not_FoundText
fields.fieldText:
{!MissingRootAssetCount} of the {!ExpectedRootAssetCount} assets to renew couldn't be read: you don't have access to them, or they were deleted. Nothing was consolidated, because a quote made without them would leave those products out of the renewal.

Ask your admin for access to the account's assets, then try again.

fields.name: Ramped_AssetsText
fields.fieldText:
An asset to renew is ramped, so nothing was consolidated. A ramped asset renews as a ramp, segment by segment, which a cotermed renewal doesn't handle.

Renew ramped assets with Generate Renewal Quote instead.

fields.name: Selection_ChangedText
fields.fieldText:
Nothing was consolidated. While you were choosing or confirming, {!Get_Primary_Opportunity.Name}, one of the selected opportunities, or the assets they renew changed: an opportunity was closed or no longer has the same account, price book and currency, or the assets to renew, their end dates, renewal terms or contract are no longer the ones you confirmed.

Run Consolidate Renewals again to see the current renewals.

subflows.description: Checks, before anything is renewed, that no root asset or bundle component was sold from a price book other than this opportunity's or is in another currency (a renewal must use those of the initial sale), or has a period in a time zone other than GMT (renewal lines inherit the asset's time zone, the end is set at 23:59:59 GMT, and one quote can't mix time zones) or in a ramp (a ramp renews segment by segment), and that none of these opportunities already has a quote and no quote on any other opportunity, open or closed, has a renewal of one of them that hasn't been ordered and activated (either could still be ordered, renewing the same assets again), and that no open opportunity left out has a line for one of them (it would stay open, and a renewal quote could still be generated from it). RLM_RenewalPreflightChecks runs in system context without sharing, because the period fields and the assets' sales are usually hidden by field-level security and a quote the user can't see still counts; it is given the root assets and opportunities the user already read and returns only a yes or no for each. Runs again after the confirmation screen.
subflows.name: Run_Preflight_Checks
subflows.label: Run Preflight Checks

subflows.description: Reads which root assets an open renewal on the account already covers. RLM_RenewalCoveredAssets runs in system context without sharing, so a renewal the user can't see still counts; it is given the root assets the user already read (CandidateAssetIds) and returns only those that are covered, never an Id found in system context. Runs again after the confirmation screen.
subflows.name: Get_Covered_Assets
subflows.label: Get Covered Assets
